name: 35634 · Florence, AL
findings: ZIP 35634 (Florence) has 21 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is volunteering, listed by 4 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 35634 (Florence) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
